reason: The 5 free dishes are already more than I'd get through in a month, especially since I still order delivery most nights. I'm not paying 99 baht up front for dishes that don't exist yet when I haven't even seen if the free ones come out right.
objection: Will my basil pork actually taste like the shop's when I follow it? If the free dishes flop I'm not paying for twelve more.
would_change_my_mind: If I cook the free dishes a few times, they come out right, and the 40-baht-a-meal plan really beats my delivery bill, I'd pay 99 baht once the pack is actually out, not as a pre-order.
